μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’) · also + dat. of place: ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσί ’in the mind’) · also + acc. of pursuit: ’after’ (μετὰ πέλειαν ’after the dove’)
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνησαμένω: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. dual: ’mindful’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μυρμιδόνεσσι: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’

μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
νέκυν: νέκυς — dead body, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νοέω: νοέω — perceive, think, form a judgment; pres. 1 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic νοῶ): ’I think’
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’) · also dat. of possession: ’his’ (οἱ ἵπποι ’his horses’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, after κατά: ’in the house, at home’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after εἰς: ’into the house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, goal after πρός: ’to the house’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οἷα: οἷος — of what sort, such as; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα in an indirect exclamation: ’what (deeds)’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔδει: οὖδας — ground, floor (Attic ἔδαφος); neut. dat. sg. οὔδει (also οὔδεϊ): ’on the floor’
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’) · also relative, object of ἑλόμην: ’which’ (of horses)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάτροκλε: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. voc. sg.
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πάτροκλόν: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. acc. sg., accent from the following enclitic θ’ (= τε)
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
πηλῆϊ: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. dat. sg., epic Πηλῆϊ (= Attic Πηλεῖ): ’to Peleus’
πλούτῳ: πλοῦτος — wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ’in (for) wealth’
ποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐποίησαν): ’they made’
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολιόν: πολιός — grey, hoary; masc. acc. sg. (also neut. nom./acc. sg.)
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πρίαμε: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. voc. sg., in address
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πραπίδων: πραπίδες — midriff, the parts about the liver; fem. gen. pl. (plural only), after ὑπό: ’beneath the midriff’ · also fem. gen. pl. after ἀπό: ’from the midriff’, i.e. from the heart
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form) · also conj. + opt., after a negative in past time: ’before, until’ (πρὶν πειρήσαιτ’ ’until he made trial’) · also conj. + inf.: ’before’ (πρὶν … εἰσαφικέσθαι ’before reaching’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)

πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, bane; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to the whole action · also neut. nom. sg., subject of λίποιτο: ’a woe (be left)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθέντες: ’woe’ (πῆμα τιθέντες ’inflicting woe’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(you are) a woe’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ’(to become) a bane’ (πῆμα γενέσθαι ’to become a bane’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’
σιδήρειόν: σιδήρειος — of iron; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic -ειος (= Attic σιδηροῦς), predicate with ἦτορ: ’iron’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (gifts)’
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀμφί: ’around you’ · also acc. sg., object of θῆκεν with a predicate acc.: ’you’ (σὲ λέοντα … θῆκεν ’made you a lion’) · also acc. sg., object of ἑλκήσουσ’: ’you’ (σὲ … ἑλκήσουσ’ ’will drag you’)
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄκοιτιν: ’your (wife)’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κραδίην: ’your (heart)’
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἑταῖρον: ’your (companion)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with γένος: ’your (offspring)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)

τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἔτεκεν)

τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τερπικέραυνος: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg.
τετάρπετο: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s fill, be satisfied; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέρφθη): ’took his pleasure’
τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν after δή: ’some (evil)’ (δή τι κακόν ’some evil’)

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’ · also masc. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that (old man)’ · also plain possessive gen.: ’his’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἀπό, of separation: ’from him’ (ἀπὸ τοῖο ’from him’) · also masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄνευθεν: ’apart from him’ (τοῖο δ’ ἄνευθεν) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation after ἀπέχω: ’from him’
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’) · also neut. acc. sg. of the place reached, with ἱκάνω: ’to this place’ (τόδ’ ἱκάνω ’I come hither’)
τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)

τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῖ: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (τῖ’ = τῖε = ἔτιε): ’honoured’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῶνδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this one; neut. gen. pl., elided (τῶνδ’ = τῶνδε): ’of these things’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’) · also neut. dat. sg., object of πίσυνος: ’trusting in it’
υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
υἱέας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἱέας (= Attic υἱούς/υἱεῖς)
υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), objective gen. with ἄποινα: ’ransom for a son’ · also masc. gen. sg., with a gen. participle, object of πυνθάνομαι: ’of his son fallen’ (υἷος ἑοῖο πεσόντος) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’of a son’ (σάκος … υἷος ’the shield of a son’)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry, bear; mid. carry for oneself, take along; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry (with oneself)’ · also pres. inf. mid./pass. of purpose: ’to be carried’ (φέρεσθαι ’to be borne away’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φασὶ: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl.: ’they say’
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. after διά: ’through the hand’ (διὰ χειρός)
χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl. · also fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with λώβην: ’unseemly (insult)’
ἀκαχήμενος: ἀχέω (ἀκαχίζω) — distress, grieve; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved, distressed’
ἀκηδέες: ἀκηδής — uncaring, negligent; masc./fem. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀκηδεῖς)
ἀλίαστον: ἀλίαστος — unceasing, relentless (rare; sense traditional); adj., acc. sg.
ἀλίτηται: ἀλιταίνω — sin against, offend; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause after ὅτις: ’whoever offends’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it · also adv. in tmesis with ἕπον: ’around’ (ἀμφί … ἕπον ’dressed’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπήνην: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, wagon; fem. acc. sg.
ἀπήνης: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, wagon; fem. gen. sg., after ἐπί: ’on the wagon’
ἀπερείσι: ἀπερείσιος — boundless, unstinted; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀπερείσι’ = ἀπερείσια)
ἀποδάσσομαι: ἀποδατέομαι — apportion, share out; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀποδάσομαι): ’I will apportion’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’) · also + a form in -θεν, ablatival: ’from’ (ἀπὸ Τροίηθεν ’from Troy’)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἁδινὰ: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, heavy; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily, in close succession’
ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
ἁψάμενος: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken hold of’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg. · also Ἄλκιμος — Alcimus, a companion of Achilles; masc. nom. sg., a name
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’ · also neut. acc. sg. as an adverb: ’for the rest’ (ἄλλο … τόσον ’for the rest, so far as’)
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’rule!’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤνασσε): ’was lord over’ (+ dat.)
ἄνσχεο: ἀνέχομαι — hold up; endure, bear with; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., apocopated ἄνσχεο (= ἀνάσχου): ’hold out’
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄϊδός: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (= Attic ᾅδου), after εἰς with δόμον understood: ’to Hades’
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; fut. 1 pl. act. + acc. and inf.: ’we will allow (him) to’ · also + acc. alone: ’leave be’ (κεῖνον ἐάσομεν ’we shall leave him be’)
ἐάσω: ἐάω — allow, let be; fut. 1 sg. act. (the form is also an aor. subj.): ’I will allow’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg., in a condition after εἰ … ἂν: ’if I allow’
ἐέργει: εἴργω — shut in, enclose; pres. 3 sg., epic ἐέργω (= Attic εἴργω)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐκέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; plpf. 3 sg. mid. (of κέκασμαι), with impf. sense, + acc.: ’excelled’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with oil’
ἐλαύνει: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; pres. 3 sg.
ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
ἐπέοικεν: ἐπέοικα (ἐπί + ἔοικα) — be fitting, be seemly (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’it befits’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. ’obey’, + dat.; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’obeyed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρέθιζε: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, irritate; pres. imper. 2 sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (ἐς Πριάμοιο ’to Priam’s’)
ἐσθλοὺς: ἐσθλός — good, brave; masc. acc. pl.
ἐφετμάς: ἐφετμή — command, bidding; fem. acc. pl.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκτορέης: Ἑκτόρεος — of Hector; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -έης (= Attic -έας), agreeing with κεφαλῆς: ’Hector’s’
ἑλλήσποντος: Ἑλλήσποντος — the Hellespont; masc. nom. sg.
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl.
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’ · also neut. nom. sg., with the article, of one’s belongings: ’his own’ (τὸ δ’ ἑὸν ’his own’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄγγελον: ’his own’
ἑῆος: ἑός — one’s own (possessive of any person); masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος; sometimes taken as gen. of ἐύς ’good’
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔλιπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor. (the form is also 3 pl.): ’I left’
ἔλυσα: λύω — loose, undo; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I loosed’ (γούνατ’ ἔλυσα ’I unstrung the knees’, i.e. killed)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔτεκεν: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’bore’
ἔτλης: τλάω — endure, dare, bring oneself to; aor. 2 sg., root aorist: ’you dared’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕκτορά: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ · also accented before the enclitic τε (θ’): ’Hector’
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἡβῶν: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth (ἥβη); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἡμιόνους: ἡμίονος — mule; masc. acc. pl.; accent from the enclitic τε
ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 1 sg. act., 2nd aor. with reduplicated stem: ’I brought’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’) · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic μιν: ’who, which’ (ἥ μιν ἔτικτε ’who bore him’)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., a courteous address: ’hero!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’came, went’
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἧμαι: ἧμαι — sit, sit still, remain; pres. 1 sg. mid.
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. after μή, in a negative purpose clause: ’lest he see’ (μή μιν ἴδοι ’lest he see her’) · also in a past general temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he looked’
ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ὀνόμηνεν: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (Attic ὀνομάζω): ’named’
ὀρίνῃς: ὀρίνω — stir, rouse, agitate; subj. act. 2 sg. (pres. or aor., same spelling), in a purpose clause with ἵνα
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχῆα: ὀχεύς — bar, bolt (of a gate); masc. acc. sg., epic ὀχῆα (= Attic ὀχέα)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄλβῳ: ὄλβος — prosperity, wealth; masc. dat. sg., dat. of respect or cause: ’in (for) prosperity’
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά σφιν … ῥύοιτο ’so that it might protect for them’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + fut. indic.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … οἴσεται ’whoever will carry off’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + opt.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … πέλοιτο ’whoever should prove’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that, because’, giving the cause of anger (χώσατο … ὅττι ’was incensed that’) · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of rejoicing, accented before the enclitic οἱ (γήθησέν τε ὅττί … ’rejoiced that …’) · also ὅττι = ὅ τι, interrogative neut. nom. sg. in an indirect question, agreeing with πένθος: ’what (grief)’ · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of announcing (ἤγγειλ’ ὅττί … ’reported that …’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’) · also + gen. of cause: ’from’ (ὑφ’ ὁρμῆς ’from the onrush’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ποσσὶν ὑφ’ ἵππων ’beneath the horses’ feet’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ … ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’stirred up’) · also + acc., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἵππους ’from under the horses’)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’roused’
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ᾕρεον: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾕρουν); with ὑπό in tmesis, ’they took away from under’ · also impf. 3 pl., with κατά … ἀπό in tmesis: ’took down off’
ᾤμωξέν: οἰμώζω — wail, cry out in distress; aor. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ- (οἰ- → ᾠ-), movable ν: ’wailed’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. sg., with πέρι: ’around which’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
